description: This file defines CLI commands for the Playwright testing framework, including test execution, report generation, server management, and agent initialization. It imports various modules for configuration, reporting, server control, and agent setup, and contains functions to add specific commands to a CLI program.

classes.name: TestServerBackend
classes.description: Backend implementation for the test server over MCP protocol.

methods.name: addTestCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'test' command to the CLI program, with options for filtering, headed mode, project selection, etc.

methods.name: addClearCacheCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'clear-cache' command to clear build and test caches.

methods.name: addDevServerCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'dev-server' command to start a development server.

methods.name: addTestServerCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'test-server' command to start a test server.

methods.name: addShowReportCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'show-report' command to display HTML reports.

methods.name: addMergeReportsCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'merge-reports' command to combine multiple report blobs into a single report.

methods.name: addBrowserMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'run-mcp-server' command for MCP interaction with the browser.

methods.name: addTestMCPServerCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'run-test-mcp-server' command for MCP interaction with the test runner.

methods.name: addInitAgentsCommand
methods.description: Adds the 'init-agents' command to initialize repository agents.

methods.name: runTests
methods.description: Executes tests based on CLI arguments and configuration, handling UI, watch mode, and standard run modes.

methods.name: runTestServer
methods.description: Starts a test server with specified host and port.

methods.name: mergeReports
methods.description: Merges multiple report blobs into a single report, with configuration options.

methods.name: overridesFromOptions
methods.description: Converts CLI options into configuration overrides for test execution.

methods.name: resolveReporterOption
methods.description: Resolves reporter string(s) into reporter descriptions.

methods.name: resolveShardOption
methods.description: Parses shard option string into current/total shard configuration.

methods.name: resolveReporter
methods.description: Resolves reporter identifiers to paths or built-in reporter names.
